senses.gloss: tipyaka, nt., acc. to Tib. as cited in note sgo bcad, locked door, but context suggests rather bucket or container attached to a rope, with which water is drawn from a well: MSV 〔i.24.14〕 (a brahman, thinking the Buddha will damage his well, tato rajjuṃ) tipyakaṃ ca gopāyitvā sthitaḥ; 〔25.1〕 (inviting Buddha to use the well) iyaṃ rajjur idaṃ tipyakam, gṛhṇātu pānīyaṃ.
